references.text: Here it is explained why Gideon was called Jerubba'al, who was Abimelek's father.
Describes Gideon's many sons, including Abimelek, who was born to his concubine in Shechem.
Specifically mentions that Abimelek was born of a concubine from Shechem, which explains his connection to his mother's family there.
The continuation of the story where Abimelek speaks to his maternal uncles and the people of Shechem.
Jotham refers back to Abimelek as the son of a slave woman and his actions against his father's house.
Shechem is mentioned as an important place in Abram's journey through Canaan.
Shechem was a city with historical significance for the people of Israel, mentioned in connection with Jacob's family.
